web.description:
# LeetCode Interview
Online coding interview platform for professionals

![Online Interview](https://leetcode.com/static/packages/interview_landing/images/online-interview.png)

## Built with the Core of LeetCode
LeetCode is the gold standard for technical interviews. As an interviewer, you are guaranteed a smooth coding experience, instant Judger results, and stable connectivity.

## An Interview Deep Dive
Understand your candidate better with more insights into memory usage, time complexity, and comparisons with millions of submissions on LeetCode.

## Free of Interruption
For the first time, you can code and solve LeetCode questions together.

## Highlights
### Live Editor
Focusing on the accuracy of judgment and efficiency, our editor and autocomplete features work seamlessly with our problems and ensure accurate runtime and memory usage.
